high_level_description: The image shows three individuals standing in front of a promotional backdrop for Netflix's documentary series "What's Next? The Future with Bill Gates." The backdrop is predominantly black with the Netflix logo in red at the top and the title of the series in white text. The text reads: "WHAT'S NEXT? THE FUTURE WITH BILL GATES." The person on the left appears to be a woman wearing a black blazer over a black top, paired with black pants and red and black sneakers. She has short, dark hair and is smiling.
